core_obligations: Preserve complete foldable-code hypotheses, balancing functions, weighted-distance folding analysis and soundness.
Keep full Kummer construction/proof and Hermitian construction/proof with generic IOPP protocol and final RS extension.
Preserve all formal parameter bounds and supporting appendix continuations; informal introduction statements are context only, not target.
difficulty_reason: The authors decompose invariant Riemann--Roch spaces over quotient curves, balance the resulting summands, and fold evaluations while preserving weighted distance. The generic proximity protocol is instantiated on Kummer curves and Hermitian towers, with distinct interpolation costs and an analysis controlling the final Reed--Solomon code.

dedup.scope: Root refreshed formal DOI, ECCC TR20-165, arxiv2011.04295 and standard arXiv DOI across complete old corpus, prepared records and both other lines, no matches. Generic folding support and the two concrete families are grouped in one author main construction.
